Hi Rachel —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the decision gate. I attached a first-pass MAP (Lakeside_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a condensed railmap below. High level: we can land an executed MSA+DPA + order form by 9/14 if Lakeside completes the procurement sign-offs and sends a PO by 9/10. If PO slips, we have a fallback to start pilot in read-only mode while signatures finalize.

Key milestones (proposed):
- 9/03: Redwood sends redlines + order form draft (attached redlines PDF)
- 9/06: Lakeside legal provides counter-redlines OR confirms accept
- 9/10: Procurement issues PO or verbal commitment to hold capacity
- 9/12: Final signoff on MSA+DPA via DocuSign (we’ll pre-populate with order form)
- 9/14: Order form executed and pilot kickoff prep
- 9/20: Pilot start (data ingest window)

Dependencies we need from Lakeside:
- PO (or written procurement commitment)
- SOC 2 evidence (we can supply a short bundle; list is in the spreadsheet)
- Network contact for VPC peering details (if going private)

I’ve looped in Laura for legal sequencing and Karthik for orderform gating — Laura, can you confirm we’re OK to push the MSA+DPA combined signature cadence and whether any internal legal review windows at Lakeside typically add >48 hours?

Next steps: If this looks ok I’ll update the HubSpot record (HS-84921) and open a DocuSign envelope pre-filled for the MSA+DPA + order form so Lakeside legal can review redlines inline.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(attachment: Lakeside_MAP_v3.xlsx; MSA_DPA_redlines_rafael.pdf)

Adding legal sequencing notes — quick read:

1) Combine MSA + DPA in one envelope: reduces signature friction and matches Lakeside’s preference for consolidated docs.
2) Redlines: I reviewed Rafael’s PDF; two asks from our side to flag for Lakeside legal: a) data residency clause (we have a standard region clause); b) indemnity threshold alignment. If Lakeside counters on either, that could add a 2–3 business day review.
3) Order form: needs annex listing pilot data sets and test SLAs. Karthik, will your order form template include the annex or should Laura provide?

Recommended cadence to hit 9/14: Lakeside legal to return counter-redlines by 9/06 EOD; procurement to issue PO by 9/10 EOB. If legal asks for material clause changes we should schedule a 30-min call 9/07 to resolve.

Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
